aarti.tek: Victory to you, Lord Mahāvīra; victory to you, Master, Lord Mahāvīra. Leader of the world, giver of happiness, Lord of great depth.
aarti.pad1: You were born in Kuṇḍalapura, the son of Triśalā; your father was King Siddhārtha; gods and men rejoiced. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Lord of the lowly and treasury of compassion, you are the bringer of good; for the good of the world you took up self-restraint; the Lord is the benefactor of others. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: You ended sinful conduct and showed the true path; you raised the banner of the dharma of compassion over the world. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Arjuna the gardener, Gautama and Śrī Candanabālā: their boat you carried across the world. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Your name is holy, the one that carries the world across; whoever meditates on you night and day, all his suffering is wiped away. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: Ocean of compassion, your greatness is beyond compare. Jñānamuni sings your virtues and gives himself at your feet. ॥6॥
